The patient's history of hypertension and high LDL-C levels suggest a diagnosis of Hypertensive Heart Disease.
The patient's history of type 2 diabetes and high LDL-C levels suggest a diagnosis of Diabetic Dyslipidemia.
The patient's medical history includes gastroesophageal reflux disease.
The patient experienced hip pain after taking statins, suggesting a diagnosis of Statins-Induced Myopathy.
The patient's high LDL-C levels, presence of Apolipoprotein B (Apo B), and Lipoprotein (a) [Lp(a)] suggest a diagnosis of Mixed Hyperlipidemia.
The patient's history of hypertension and high LDL-C levels suggest a diagnosis of Cardiovascular Disease.
